newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex to offer flat callrate - paper.
newsitem.headline: Telmex to offer flat callrate - paper.

text.p: Mexico's telephone giant Telefonos de Mexico SA (Telmex) will offer clients a single tariff day and night call rate, Reforma daily said Wednesday.
Telmex will annouce the flat tariff rate soon, Reforma said, citing the company chairman Carlos Slim.
Company spokesmen were not immediately available for comment.
Alestra, a telephone venture between AT&T, Grupo Industrial Alfa and financial firm Grupo Financiero Bancomer has a flat rate of 1.30 pesos per minute.
Avantel, a venture between financial company Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival and MCI Corp. has a flat rate of 1.40 pesos per minute.
